guard: a once task is handed to the harness at most once per seat process: the claim is a permit, a seal is final, a claimed or sealed task is offered to no one, a settled task takes no permit, the handoff timer measures the dispatch only, and a report that cannot land ends the seat
why: M1 lets a second caller holding the same stale peek take the permit: two sends of one task.
M2 lets a late acceptance confirm a sealed task, so an automatic yield follows for a task the
manager already failed. M3 offers a claimed task again, so a held task is sent twice. M4 and M5
let a send queued behind a gate claim a task its manager settled meanwhile. M6 keeps the timer
running after the dispatch left, so a slow response seals a task the harness has. M7 leaves a
seat whose report cannot land running, with the task open and nothing to end it.
M8 drops the forced exit, so a seat whose graceful shutdown stalls keeps its process, with its task
open and nothing left to end it.

mutations.name: M1 the claim takes a task that is no longer pending
mutations.expectRed: the first claim succeeds and the second, from the same stale peek, takes nothing

mutations.name: M2 an acceptance confirms a sealed task
mutations.expectRed: a late acceptance after the seal surfaces nothing, so no automatic yield follows

mutations.name: M3 a claimed task is offered again
mutations.expectRed: a claimed task is offered by no peek and wakes nothing, so a held task drives no blank retry

mutations.name: M4 a settle seals only a claimed task
mutations.expectRed: the settle ends the handoff, and a dispatch queued behind a gate is refused its permit

mutations.name: M5 the claim treats a settled once task as a run turn
mutations.expectRed: the settle ends the handoff, and a dispatch queued behind a gate is refused its permit

mutations.name: M6 noting the dispatch leaves the handoff timer running
mutations.find: for (const id of goalIds) if (this.activeTurns.get(id)?.once !== undefined) stopOnceHandoffTimer(this.onceUid(), id);
mutations.expectRed: noting the dispatch stops the timer, so a slow first response is never ended by it

mutations.name: M7 a report that never lands leaves the seat running
mutations.expectRed: a report that cannot land within the bound starts the seat's graceful shutdown and then exits its process

mutations.name: M8 a seat whose shutdown stalls is never forced out
mutations.expectRed: its shutdown starts, and the process exits one grace period later with its teardown still holding the event loop
